context: November 17 gave direct positive momentum and buyers came in. NIFTY and Sensex then rejected, but in a market this positive traders do not leave on a rejection, and buy again on the recovery.
plan: FLAT TO GAP DOWN -> SELL: target the buyers who came in; identify selling-side setups.
GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: the buyers see no danger and cannot be targeted; an opening above yesterday's high suits it best; identify buying-side setups.
